The chapter gives more than one bacterial/prokaryotic size range in different contexts: 0.01–0.5 µm in the cell-size paragraph, 0.003–2.0 µm in the prokaryotic prose, and 1–2 µm in the comparison table. Questions preserve the context of each stated range rather than forcing one value.
The evaluation asks to arrange organism and egg lists but does not state an ordering criterion or direction. Those ambiguous sequencing prompts are not given an invented unique answer.
The evaluation clue comparing a cell part to a policeman is answered from the chapter table: the cell membrane is the gate of the cell and controls movement of materials in and out.
